rationale.edition: Changed paths span both repos: the bulk are OSS frontend files under web/src/** (the ingestion setup-card components and 16 locale files), and there is one enterprise-owned path o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/alerts/default_semantic_groups.json plus its OSS counterpart web/src/views/Infrastructure/curated/packs/__fixtures__/semanticGroups.default.json. The diff header marks these two semanticGroups files as a linked OSS+ENT sister pair, so the combined diff is 'both'. No enterprise keyword in prose drove the call — the enterprise path is the signal.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no explicit opt-out (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty, no tests-added label), and the change is user-facing: it rewrites the ingestion setup-card flow with new variant toggles, per-variant inputs and validation warnings in web/src/**.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. SetupCardRenderer.vue and its Linux/Kubernetes/Windows content gain new user-exercisable UI: a 'Logs & metrics' vs 'Logs, metrics & eBPF traces' toggle, a nested 'language libraries' vs 'eBPF' toggle, per-variant trace inputs, a 'fill in at least one selector' warning, and flag/Helm escaping — all of which a user can click through in the connect-data-source flow.
rationale.area: Streams — the ingestion setup cards live in the connect-data-source/ingestion flow, and the existing specs closest to it (ingestion-config.spec.js, connectDataSourcePopup.spec.js) are already under the Streams area. There is no dedicated 'Ingestion' or 'DataSources' folder in the suite.
rationale.group: Streams — the Streams shard in ci_matrix_env.json / ci_matrix_cloud.json is the closest existing group whose run_files already hold ingestion/connect-data-source specs, so the new setup-card spec belongs there.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only tests added are Vitest unit specs under web/src/components/ingestion/**/*.spec.ts, which are not Playwright E2E coverage and do not set existing_tests_in_diff.
